Mirra Andreeva saved two match points trailing Olga Danilovic 5-2 in the third set of their Iasi semifinal, pulling through 3-6, 6-3, 7-6(1) to reach her first WTA final.
Mirra Andreeva notched her first tour-level win from match point down in Round 3 of the Australian Open, coming from 5-1 down in the decider (saving one at 5-2) to beat Diane Parry 1-6, 6-1, 7-6[6].

title: Mirra Andreeva, 16, reached the fourth round of Wimbledon as a qualifier playing her fourth tour-level event, and first at any level on grass. She rose to No.66 on Jul. 17, becoming the first 2007-born player to enter the Top 100.

title: Mirra Andreeva, Alina Korneeva - 2023 Australian Open

Mirra Andreeva, 15, took Anastasia Potapova to three sets after receiving a wildcard into Monastir. Andreeva has started her pro career with a 30-7 record and three titles in her first nine ITF events this year.
